subject: CloudLens GCP listing: intake checklist, SKU mapping & procurement handoff
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-partner@google.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cloudlens.ai>, CloudLens Procurement <procurement@cloudlens.ai>
Date: 2026-08-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: CloudLens GCP listing: intake checklist, SKU mapping & procurement handoff

Team + Tom —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. CloudLens is ready to move their listing forward and wants clarity on the procurement path so their customers can purchase through GCP Marketplace (billing via GCP). I attached the intake checklist and an initial SKU spreadsheet from their finance team. High-level asks: 

- Confirm SKU-to-product mapping and any SKU name adjustments we recommend for resale on GCP.
- Identify billing/legal handoffs required for Marketplace listing (DocuSign, seller agreement variations).
- Confirm expected timeline for listing review + co-sell enablement steps.

Proposed owners: 
- Technical listing intake and SKU tuning: Karthik
- Billing & GCP procurement ops: Rishi
- Deal / partner coordination & contract redlines: Aditya

Tom — if you can confirm CloudLens's licensing model (subscription vs. seat-based vs. usage) and the procurement contact for PO/invoice routing, we can finalize the SKU mapping and hand this to Procurement.

Next steps: I’ll schedule a 30-min working session Weds to align SKU names and finalize the draft seller agreement. Please review attached files before then.

Attachments: CloudLens_GCP_Intake_Checklist.pdf; CloudLens_SKU_Mapping_v1.csv

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cloudlens.ai>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudLens GCP listing: intake checklist, SKU mapping & procurement handoff

Vanessa —

Thanks, attaching a few inline notes after a quick pass of the CSV. Quick clarifications:

- Licensing model: if CloudLens is usage-based, we should model SKUs as "unit-per-1k-requests" or similar. Seat-based/licensed should be a separate SKU with clear monthly term. Tom, can you confirm?
- Is multi-tenant (hosted) expected or are they listing both hosted + BYO (private) SKUs? We need to reflect that in product descriptions.

I put recommended SKU name tweaks in the Drive link (see related_links). Also, for the technical listing intake, I'll own mapping adjustments and the initial manifest for GCP vetting. Rishi — can you surface any known blockers for billing mapping (tax settings, invoice flow) that we should flag to CloudLens procurement?

If everyone agrees, I’ll prepare a manifest draft by Tuesday EOD and share for review.

Date: 2026-08-26T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudLens GCP listing: intake checklist, SKU mapping & procurement handoff

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick answers: 

- Licensing: CloudLens is proposing a monthly subscription per-account (tiered by usage). There will be a small surcharge for additional storage; we can capture that as an add-on SKU.
- Deployment models: initially hosted only (CloudLens managed). They may add a BYO option later; for now please treat as a single hosting SKU with add-on storage SKU.
- Procurement contact: procurement@cloudlens.ai (cc’d). For POs, the legal entity is CloudLens, Inc. and they can accept standard marketplace terms with minor redlines (data retention clause).

Attached is a cleaned SKU list and their procurement playbook (PDF) — helps explain invoice routing. We’d like to be live by mid-September ideally. Can you confirm what the gating items are from your side?

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Head of Partnerships
CloudLens
Tom.Ellis@cloudlens.ai
+1 206-555-0199

Attachments: CloudLens_SKU_Mapping_Cleaned.csv; CloudLens_Procurement_Playbook.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cloudlens.ai>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudLens GCP listing: intake checklist, SKU mapping & procurement handoff

Team —

Quick billing ops notes after reviewing Tom’s attachments: 

- Recommended: consolidate the "storage surcharge" into a metered add-on SKU (easier to reconcile on GCP invoices).
- Tax & invoicing: CloudLens’s entity looks US-based; we’ll need their W-9 and banking details before final seller agreement signature.
- DocuSign: I attached our standard Marketplace Seller Agreement (draft) with the marketplace-specific clauses pre-filled. Please review section 3.2 (billing flow) and 7.4 (data retention).

Blocking items for go-live: 
1) W-9 + bank info from CloudLens procurement.
2) Final SKU manifest with unit definitions and sample pricing.
3) DocuSign signature from CloudLens legal on the seller agreement.

I put comments into the Drive draft (see related_links) and marked the preferred invoice routing (GCP collects, pays CloudLens net-30).

All —

Good progress, thanks. Summary & next steps: 

1) Karthik: deliver the SKU manifest v2 (unit defs + adjusted names) by Tue 2026-08-31 EOD.
2) Rishi: confirm if the seller agreement draft needs additional marketplace clause edits; if not, send DocuSign to CloudLens procurement after W-9 is received.
3) Aditya: I’ll route any required redlines for legal and own the HubSpot deal updates (RDW-DEAL-8392).
4) Tom / CloudLens: please upload W-9 + banking remittance details to the secure Drive folder and confirm acceptance of the net-30 payout terms.

I'll book a 30-min triage on Wed 2026-09-01 09:00 PT with GCP listing ops to confirm final manifest and share the draft seller agreement. Calendar invite to follow.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deals/RDW-DEAL-8392) — please tag any items you complete there.

Attachments: RDW_Marketplace_Seller_Agreement_Draft.docx

Thanks everyone — aiming for a mid-September live date.
